property_summary: For every input, C.proxiableUUID() must return the ERC1967 implementation slot bytes32(0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc); the mutant returns bytes32(0), violating the rule for any input.
change_summary: Return zero instead of the implementation slot, so proxiableUUID returns a different bytes32 value.
